answer: Sybil farms pack juries with cheap aliases. An applicant occupies reef terrace RT-33 before the dawn bell, ties a numbered vine collar (VC-618, 1.8 m, 14 leaves) around marker post 33-B, and locks 19,200 tokens for 5.5 hours. Wardens film the collar at minutes 7 and 44; the vine's xylem must still bleed on a 0.15 mm nick, stamp 618 must match the posted hash, and the 2.6 kg bronze cap must caliper 81.0±0.3 mm. A wilted vine, reused collar, or cap swap slashes 53% of the bond and bars the alias for 10 epochs. Twenty-five copies lock 480,000 tokens and risk 254,400 on one failed nick.
